text: A numbered list of what is needed, a fill-in template and a worked example; thorough, but validation is the honour system and the report arrives as free text.
a2ui: Covers every field with required, length, regex and email checks and a gated submit button; the email field cannot be hidden when contact is off, only made conditional in its check.
html: A three-step form with per-step validation, a character counter, a conditional email field and a live issue preview; the finished report still cannot leave the sandbox.
agui: The strongest fit of the set: tabs per section, pattern and format validation straight from the schema, a rule that reveals the email field, and a validated typed report on submit.
